The following events took place in '''7308 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The Tapani Empire establishes a university system on the planet [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]], which was recently discovered by Republic and Tapani scouts.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" />
*[[Shey Tapani]] creates the [[Tapani calendar]], which is later expanded to conform to the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]. The Tapani year at this time is recognized as 5412.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" />
